title: Publish-triggered alerts per list rule, deduplicated per item per list
description: Hook on the publish path (newsroom and CLI) when PublishResult.changed: async invoke newsletter item-published. Rules by section, tag or type; dedupe per lineage per list; approval gate per list, instant sends only when the site enables them. Never fails a publish.
